encounters.scenario: A customer shopping for a basic television considers and accepts a premium model upgrade, then adds an extended warranty after reviewing the coverage.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good evening, sir. What are you looking for today?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: A basic 43-inch smart TV. Around twenty-five thousand, mainly for news and cricket.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: This one is ₹23,990. It's a 43-inch smart TV, and the usual streaming apps are included. The remote is here if you want to try it.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Looks okay from here. We have a window opposite the TV, though. Will the picture look dull during the day?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Some reflection will be there. You could consider this premium 43-inch model at ₹30,990 instead. It has a brighter panel and better reflection handling. Shall I show you the same cricket clip on both?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes, please. Seven thousand extra is quite a jump. Apart from the screen, what changes?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: The premium one also has stronger built-in speakers and an extra HDMI port. Both have the apps you asked about, and both come with a one-year manufacturer's warranty.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Let me watch for a minute... Yes, I can see the difference on the grass and the players' faces. We keep our TVs for years. Okay, I'll take the ₹30,990 one.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sure, sir. Would you also like an extended warranty for ₹2,999? It adds two years of coverage after the manufacturer's first year, so the total coverage period becomes three years.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Another three thousand? Let me understand it first. Does it cover the panel, or only the smaller parts?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: This plan covers electrical and mechanical failures, including panel failure, subject to the written terms. Accidental damage and a cracked screen aren't covered. Here, these are the coverage and exclusions sections.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Give me a moment to read this... Okay, I understand it's not accidental-damage cover. Fine, add the extended warranty also.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: That makes ₹33,989 for the TV and extended warranty together. I'll list them separately on the bill. Shall I arrange delivery to your home?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes, please. Tomorrow afternoon would be good. I'll give you the address, and please include the warranty document with the bill.

encounters.notes: The proactive premium-model recommendation and extended-warranty offer are the two upsell attempts. Product comparisons and coverage explanations answer customer questions and are not separate attempts. The customer considers and accepts both offers.

encounters.scenario: Customer apni pasand ka laptop kharidne aata hai. Salesperson discounted mouse aur sleeve bundle offer karta hai, jo customer accept kar leta hai.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Hello sir, bataiye, kya dikhaun?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Ye display wala Lenovo laptop chahiye, 16 GB RAM aur 512 SSD wala. Kya price hai?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sir, ye 42,990 ka hai, GST included. Same configuration ka sealed piece available hai.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Mainly Excel aur video calls ke liye hai. Ek baar keyboard aur screen check kar loon?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Haan sir, aaram se. Ye demo unit pe Excel khol deta hoon, aap typing bhi check kar lijiye.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, keyboard theek lag raha hai. Yehi laptop final kar do.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Bilkul sir. Iske saath wireless mouse aur padded sleeve ka bundle bhi hai. Alag lenge toh dono 2,098 ke hain, laptop ke saath 1,499 mein padenge. Add karna chahenge?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Achha, matlab 1,499 mein mouse aur sleeve dono? Sleeve is laptop ko fit aayegi?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji, dono included hain. Ye isi size ki sleeve hai, dekhiye, laptop easily fit ho raha hai aur zip bhi properly band ho rahi hai.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Theek hai, dono add kar do. Office le jaane ke liye sleeve bhi kaam aa jayegi.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Done sir. Laptop aur bundle mila ke total 44,489 hoga. Payment card se karenge ya UPI?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: UPI karunga. Bill mere naam pe bana dena, number bata deta hoon.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji sir. Details le leta hoon, phir sealed box ka serial number bill se match karwa deta hoon. Mouse aur sleeve bhi saath pack kar denge.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, perfect. QR dikha do, payment kar deta hoon.

encounters.notes: Turn 7 is the sole proactive upsell: a discounted mouse-and-sleeve bundle beyond the requested laptop. The customer accepts in turn 10. Fit clarification, total confirmation, and billing are not additional upsell attempts.

encounters.scenario: ग्राहक फोन खरीदने आया है। कवर और टेम्पर्ड ग्लास का कॉम्बो मना करने पर विक्रेता केवल सस्ता टेम्पर्ड ग्लास लेने का सुझाव देता है, जिसे ग्राहक स्वीकार कर लेता है।

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: जी भाईसाहब, बताइए, कौन-सा फोन देखना है?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: कल जो 128 जीबी वाला फोन देखा था, 14,999 का, वही लेना है। नीले रंग में है?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: हाँ जी, नीला है। ये रहा सीलबंद डिब्बा। बिल इसी नाम से बना दूँ जो आपने कल बताया था?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: हाँ, राजेश कुमार। फोन खोलकर एक बार चालू भी कर दीजिएगा।

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: बिल्कुल। इसके साथ कवर और टेम्पर्ड ग्लास का कॉम्बो लगा दूँ? दोनों मिलाकर 699 रुपये पड़ेंगे।

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: नहीं भैया, 699 और नहीं खर्च करने। अभी बस फोन ही दीजिए।

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: ठीक है, कॉम्बो छोड़ दीजिए। सिर्फ साधारण टेम्पर्ड ग्लास लगवा लीजिए, 199 का है। कवर फिर कभी ले लेना।

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: 199 में लगाकर देंगे न? लगाने का अलग से तो नहीं है?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: नहीं जी, लगाने समेत 199 हैं। आपके सामने साफ करके लगा दूँगा।

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: अच्छा, तो सिर्फ ये ग्लास लगा दीजिए। कवर नहीं चाहिए।

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: जी, सिर्फ फोन और एक टेम्पर्ड ग्लास। कुल 15,198 रुपये हुए। भुगतान कैसे करेंगे?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: यूपीआई कर देता हूँ। ये सामने वाला क्यूआर है?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: हाँ जी, इसी पर। भुगतान आ गया है। ये आपका बिल, और फोन भी चालू हो गया है। अब ग्लास लगा देता हूँ।

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: ठीक है भैया, लगा दीजिए। डिब्बा भी साथ रख देना।

encounters.notes: पहला प्रयास कवर और टेम्पर्ड ग्लास का कॉम्बो बेचने का है। ग्राहक के मना करने के बाद दूसरा प्रयास केवल 199 रुपये का टेम्पर्ड ग्लास बेचने का है। ग्राहक यही एक छोटा अतिरिक्त सामान स्वीकार करता है। लगाने के शुल्क की जानकारी देना और स्वीकृत वस्तुओं का बिल बनाना नए अपसेल प्रयास नहीं हैं।
